annotation.title_clean: Intelligent and connected vehicle—General technical requirements for automated driving system (GB/T 44721-2024)
annotation.title_en: Intelligent and connected vehicle—General technical requirements for automated driving system (GB/T 44721-2024)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: National Technical Committee 114 on Road Vehicles (SAC/TC114/SC34), Standardization Administration of China
annotation.summary_en: Catalogue page for Chinese national standard GB/T 44721-2024, general technical requirements for automated driving systems in intelligent connected vehicles, issued 2024-09-29 by TC114/SC34. It shows only metadata and related standards, such as the mandatory GB 44721-2026 safety requirements and the data recording system standard GB 44497-2024.
key_provisions_or_claims: GB/T 44721-2024 sets general technical requirements for automated driving systems, issued 2024-09-29
Related GB 44721-2026 sets safety requirements for automated driving systems
Related GB 44497-2024 covers automated driving data recording systems
Lists associated standards on functional safety, SOTIF, operational safety monitoring platforms and automated parking
